info.title: Talvora Talent Operations API

get.description:
Unauthenticated liveness probe.

Indicates the FastAPI application process is alive and accepting connections.
Does NOT depend on external database, cloud, or AI availability.

Readiness probe checking core database and dependency availability.

Returns HTTP 200 when core database is healthy.
Returns HTTP 503 if core relational persistence is unreachable.
Optional integrations appear as degraded capabilities rather than taking down the service.

200.description: Service is ready to handle traffic

get.description:
Non-production diagnostic route for runtime verification.

Active strictly in local or test environments. Returns 404 in staging/production.
Initiates OIDC Authorization Code Flow with PKCE.

ContactVerificationRequest.title: ContactVerificationRequest
ContactVerificationRequest.description:
Human command recording source, actor, exact address, and contact version.

This endpoint is NOT proof of mailbox ownership; it records a human attestation
bound to an exact contact revision version.

is_proof_of_ownership.title: Is Proof Of Ownership
is_proof_of_ownership.description: Always false in this phase: a verification is a recorded human attestation, not independent proof of mailbox ownership.

ContactVerificationResponse.title: ContactVerificationResponse
ContactVerificationResponse.description: Details of a recorded contact verification command.

ContactVerificationSource.title: ContactVerificationSource
ContactVerificationSource.description:
How a human attested to an exact contact address.

This is a record of a human command, not independent proof of mailbox ownership.
Proof of ownership requires a separate verification flow (e.g. a confirmed reply or
link click) that is not implemented in this phase.

CreateApplicationRequest.title: CreateApplicationRequest
CreateApplicationRequest.description:
Payload to create an application for an existing or a newly created candidate.

Supply either `candidate_id` for an existing candidate, or new candidate fields
(which may all be omitted for an unverified draft upload-intake candidate).

CreateCandidateRequest.title: CreateCandidateRequest
CreateCandidateRequest.description:
Payload to create a candidate identity.

A draft upload-intake candidate requires no invented name or address: set
`is_draft=true` and omit display_name/email/phone entirely if unknown.

CreateCandidateResponse.title: CreateCandidateResponse
CreateCandidateResponse.description: Candidate creation result including conservative, minimum-exposure duplicates.

StageTransitionRequest.description:
Payload for a human-authorized pipeline stage transition.

`expected_version` is mandatory: it is the version the actor observed before issuing
this command, and guards against acting on stale/concurrent state.

UpdateCandidateRequest.title: UpdateCandidateRequest
UpdateCandidateRequest.description:
Payload to update candidate contact/display details.

Any contact field supplied appends a new immutable contact revision. If the
candidate's current contact was previously verified, this invalidates that verified
status (the verified revision version no longer matches the current one) until a
recruiter verifies the new contact again.
